The user does not have to run the file as a script or paste a command supplied by the attacker. items.description: A low-skilled hacker used a jailbroken AI agent to steal an insurer’s customer database and about 8.6GB of files from European municipalities. The operator, known as BabidiGhost, worked for nine days in November 2026. He typed plain, misspelled French orders and let the agent do the technical work. items.description: Microsoft confirmed printing issues on systems running Forcepoint DLP software after installing the KB5132043 November 2026 Windows 11 hotpatch. [...]

items.title: Hackers Exploited GL.iNet Cloud Flaw to Install Malware on Routers and KVM Devices
items.description: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud remote management service to install malware on some customer routers and KVM devices, the maker of travel routers and remote-access KVM hardware said in a security notice updated today. The company identified and fixed the flaw on Friday and blocked the access the attacker used, so devices can no longer be infected through this route.
